sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B BTProp tree-gen SFT (main_modified1_verify prompts) Fine-tuned from Qwen3-8B to perform belief-tree generation for the BTProp fact-checking pipeline. Distilled from Qwen3.5-397B (≈50× larger) trajectories on 9 fact-checking datasets so the BTProp tree-gen stage no longer needs a 397B teacher at inference time.
